config.pvp_optimize.title: PvP-Optimize Settings
When ON, other players beyond the skin-layer hide distance with all 6 equipment slots empty are not rendered at all.
Players wearing anything are unaffected and still render normally.
When EnhancedBlockEntities / MoreCulling are present, skip our own block-entity distance culling to avoid double-Mixin overhead. Does not affect entity culling.
config.pvp_optimize.entityCullingGuardEn:
When enabled and EntityCulling is present, disable our own distance-based entity culling entirely.
EntityCulling only does frustum/occlusion culling, which complements distance culling, so this is off by default. If far entities are not being culled, make sure this stays off.
config.pvp_optimize.memoryAdaptiveEnable:
Shrink cull distances (75% / 50%) when heap usage is high or GC pauses spike, cutting allocation rate and GC frequency.
Changes distant visuals; off by default.
config.pvp_optimize.diagnosticsLogEnable: Write heap usage, GC counts/time and overlapping-mod state into latest.log at startup, on pressure change and every 60s. No HUD.
config.pvp_optimize.adaptiveEnabled.tool:
Inspired by Lagometer: samples frame times in a ring buffer, then shrinks entity cull distance, particle budget and animation-tick rate when frames slow down.
Hysteresis and a cooldown prevent oscillation near the threshold.
config.pvp_optimize.particleDistanceCull: An extra distance gate on top of the existing type whitelist. The whitelist itself is unchanged.
config.pvp_optimize.particleBudgetEnable: Caps the number of particles rendered per frame, keeping FPS stable during large explosions or fireworks.
config.pvp_optimize.smartTextureAnimatio:
Inspired by SmartAnimations: identical to vanilla at normal FPS; under load, animated block/particle atlas updates drop to every 2-3 frames.
Does not touch chunk meshes, so it stays compatible with Sodium.
config.pvp_optimize.pauseMenuRelocateEna:
Moves the pause menu's Disconnect (multiplayer) / Return to Menu (singleplayer) button from the bottom grid to the top-left corner.
Only the button coordinates change; the vanilla button grid is untouched, so it does not conflict with mods that also inject into the pause screen.
Turn off to restore the vanilla position.
config.pvp_optimize.pauseMenuPosition.to: Pixel offset from the top-left corner of the screen. Defaults to 4, 4. Re-applied on window resize; out-of-bounds values are clamped.
config.pvp_optimize.pauseMenuExitButtonW: 0 keeps the vanilla button width; a smaller value such as 100 makes the corner button more compact.
config.pvp_optimize.musicPlayerEnabled.t:
Fully offline player: reads MP3 / WAV / OGG from config/pvp_optimize/music/.
Decoding runs on a separate thread; no network, no render-frame cost. Press M to open the player.
config.pvp_optimize.musicHudEnabled: Feed local player into Dango island
config.pvp_optimize.musicAutoPlay.toolti: Remembers the queue, current track, position, volume and repeat mode when the game closes.
config.pvp_optimize.musicDuckVanilla.too: Only pauses vanilla MUSIC scheduling; sound effects and ambient sounds are untouched.
gui.pvp_optimize.music.title: PvP-Optimize Music Player
gui.pvp_optimize.music.empty: Put MP3 / WAV / OGG files into %s, then press Refresh folder
gui.pvp_optimize.title: PvP-Optimize
gui.pvp_optimize.subtitle: All-in-one control panel
gui.pvp_optimize.search.hint: Search by name, description or tab
gui.pvp_optimize.player.empty: Put MP3 / WAV / OGG files into config/pvp_optimize/music/ then click Rescan. Subfolders and matching .lrc lyrics are supported.
gui.pvp_optimize.info.music_dir: Music folder (defaults to this game instance, override in config):
gui.pvp_optimize.info.particles: The whitelist is unchanged: only PvP-critical particles (crit / sweep, damage hearts, spell, note) are kept. Distance culling and the per-frame budget are a second, independent layer.
gui.pvp_optimize.info.particles_advanced: Particle distance culling and the per-frame budget live in the Adaptive Performance tab.
gui.pvp_optimize.info.culling: Whitelist: players, villagers, snowballs, ender pearls, arrows, potions / XP bottles / eggs, primed TNT, mineral drops and bosses are always kept. Everything else is culled beyond the configured radius.
gui.pvp_optimize.tip.1: H toggles the panel, M opens the music tab, U opens the HUD layout editor. The search box accepts Chinese, English and raw config keys; Ctrl+F focuses it, Ctrl+V pastes.
gui.pvp_optimize.tip.2: Every change applies immediately and is written to config/pvp_optimize.json. Sliders can be clicked or dragged; values and hex colors can be typed directly.
gui.pvp_optimize.tip.3: P / K / J toggle particles, entity culling and the red overlay; V / N / B control music; U adjusts HUD position and size.
gui.pvp_optimize.tip.keys: Rebind these in Options > Controls > PvP-Optimize. This page only shows current bindings.
config.pvp_optimize.guiPauseWorldRenderi: Legacy option: skipping world rendering made the screen black and has been removed. Use Slight background dim instead.
config.pvp_optimize.guiWindowSize.toolti: Compact / Standard / Large. The header button cycles sizes; drag the title bar to move the window.
config.pvp_optimize.onlineMusicEnabled.t: Search / download / folder import. Disabling blocks all network actions on the online page.
config.pvp_optimize.onlineSearchLimit.to: Maximum number of tracks returned per keyword search.
gui.pvp_optimize.section.keybinds_edit: Keybinds (click a key chip to rebind)
gui.pvp_optimize.tip.rebind: Click a key chip to capture a new key. Press any key to bind, Esc to unbind, right-click to unbind, or click to bind a mouse button. Conflicts are unbound automatically, like the vanilla Controls screen. HUD key hints refresh immediately.
gui.pvp_optimize.info.gui: The panel backdrop is three flat colour bands (no blur, no post-processing), so opening it no longer costs frames. With "None" the world stays untouched and the panel layers itself.
gui.pvp_optimize.info.online: Built-in source: Netease Cloud Music (playable MP3 with matching .lrc). Kugou / QQ lossless or encrypted formats (FLAC / M4A) cannot be decoded here - use Direct URL or Folder Import for MP3 / WAV / OGG from other downloaders.
gui.pvp_optimize.online.idle: Ready: search by keyword, paste a direct URL, or set a LenoMusic downloads folder.
gui.pvp_optimize.online.hint: No results yet. Enter a song or artist and press Search; click a result to download into the music folder (playlist refreshes automatically).
gui.pvp_optimize.online.disclaimer: This feature only fetches public direct links on your request and saves them locally; no audio is bundled. Copyright belongs to the platforms and rights holders - use only for personal study or backup of purchased content. VIP / paid / trial clips may not resolve.
gui.pvp_optimize.online.need_dir: Enter an external download folder first (e.g. LenoMusic downloads).
gui.pvp_optimize.online.bad_url: URL must start with http:// or https://.
gui.pvp_optimize.online.bad_dir: Folder does not exist or the path is invalid.
gui.pvp_optimize.online.disabled: Online music is disabled in Interface settings.
gui.pvp_optimize.online.no_result: No results. Try another keyword or use Direct URL.
gui.pvp_optimize.online.no_url: Could not resolve a direct link:
gui.pvp_optimize.online.too_small: Downloaded file is too small (trial clip or error page).
gui.pvp_optimize.info.hud_layout: Badlion style: both the potion panel and the lyrics panel can be repositioned and resized. Press U (or the HUD button) to edit: click to select, drag, scroll to scale, right-click to reset. The music island itself is controlled by Dango.
gui.pvp_optimize.hud_editor.title: HUD Layout
gui.pvp_optimize.hud_editor.tip: Click to select - drag to move - scroll to scale - right-click to reset
config.pvp_optimize.hudCustomLayoutEnabl: When off, falls back to the legacy corner docking. When on, uses the absolute coordinates and scale below; press U for the visual drag editor.
config.pvp_optimize.potionHudX.tooltip: -1 = auto right; otherwise pixels from the left edge.
config.pvp_optimize.potionHudY.tooltip: Pixels from the top edge. Default 8.
config.pvp_optimize.potionHudScale.toolt: 50% ~ 200%, same layout rules as the music HUD.
config.pvp_optimize.musicVolume.tooltip: Perceptual volume curve with a master gain cap (100% is only about -10.5 dB), so it no longer drowns out game sounds. Useful range 20~60%.
config.pvp_optimize.musicIslandExpand: Island - expand on track change / pause
config.pvp_optimize.musicIslandExpand.to: Spring-animate the pill into a large card with cover, title and progress when the track changes or playback pauses/resumes (DangoMusic style).
config.pvp_optimize.musicIslandGlass.too: On = glass pill with highlight and rim; off = solid black pill (DangoMusic's plain option).
config.pvp_optimize.musicIslandNotifySec: How long the expanded card stays after a track change or pause, 1-10 seconds.
config.pvp_optimize.hudEditorHint: Press U or use the title screen HUD Layout button to open the visual editor: drag to move, scroll / corner handle to resize, right-click to reset, Esc to save. You can also type coordinates below. The music island is rendered by DangoMusic; adjust it in Dango's own settings.
gui.pvp_optimize.dango.title: DangoMusic - Official Liquid Glass Player
gui.pvp_optimize.dango.desc: Online library - Dynamic Island - Lyrics (official client bundled)
config.pvp_optimize.guiGlassOpacity.tool: 24% matches the official Dango tint. Higher is more solid and more readable; lower is clearer and more glass-like.
gui.pvp_optimize.hud_editor.tip2: Tab or the chips switch potion / lyrics - Esc saves
config.pvp_optimize.musicHudEnabled.tool: Title / artist / cover / progress / pause state of the local player are written into DangoMusic's official island and rendered by its own liquid-glass pipeline. This mod no longer draws a player HUD itself.
config.pvp_optimize.islandScale.tooltip: 60% - 160%; writes Dango's own island scale, applied instantly.
config.pvp_optimize.guiBackdrop.tooltip: Three flat horizontal bands - no GPU post-processing at all. The old "liquid glass" 6-pass blur was the single cause of GUI stutter and has been removed. "None" leaves the world untouched and relies on the panel layering alone.
config.pvp_optimize.lyricsHudEnabled.too: Dango-styled 2D lyric panel: current line highlighted, neighbours faded, inline progress. Local tracks read a matching .lrc (UTF-8 / GBK); Dango online tracks fetch the official lyrics automatically. Appearance options mirror the potion HUD (backdrop colour/opacity, text colours).
config.pvp_optimize.lyricsHudLines.toolt: 1-5 lines, default 3 (current + one above and below).
config.pvp_optimize.lyricsHudBg.tooltip: Turn off for text only, without the rounded dark card.
config.pvp_optimize.lyricsHudBgOpacity.t: 0 = fully transparent (text only), 100 = fully opaque. Same meaning as the potion HUD backdrop opacity.
config.pvp_optimize.lyricsHudBgColor.too: Hex RGB, e.g. 0B0E15 (dark glass) or 000000 (pure black). Transparency comes from the entry above.
config.pvp_optimize.lyricsHudHighlightCo: Colour of the line being sung, default sky blue 4C8DFF.
config.pvp_optimize.lyricsHudTextColor.t: Base colour for upcoming/past lines; past lines fade to 55% automatically.
config.pvp_optimize.lyricsHudRounded.too: On = rounded card with hairline border (Dango style); off = plain rectangle (potion HUD style).
config.pvp_optimize.lyricsHudShadow.tool: Turn off to drop the text shadow and half the text vertices.
config.pvp_optimize.lyricsHudProgress.to: The thin progress line at the bottom of the panel that follows the current line.
config.pvp_optimize.lyricsHudX.tooltip: -1 = auto (top centre, right below the dynamic island).
config.pvp_optimize.lyricsHudY.tooltip: -1 = auto (42 px below the dynamic island).
config.pvp_optimize.lyricsHudScale.toolt: 50% - 200%, draggable and scalable like the potion panel.
config.pvp_optimize.hudLiteMode.tooltip: One switch that lowers everything costing frame time: island liquid glass, lyric text shadow, lyric line count, backdrop opacity.
gui.pvp_optimize.info.hud_cost: The “HUD island x.xx ms / lyrics x.xx ms / potion x.xx ms” line on the overview card is measured every frame. If the island dominates, switch the power mode to Saver (drops the liquid glass); if lyrics dominate, use fewer lines or turn off the text shadow.
